name: Atwood Lake Park
evidence: Kept on AWH's 2026-10-31 reading of MWCD's engine map: Area F (604-702) on a peninsula with the lake on both sides. Satellite at 40.5400,-81.2718 agrees: RV pads at the shoreline with docks. Area H per-site tags not read; not needed for the value.

name: Mary Jane Thurston State Park
evidence: ReserveOhio per-site plot + satellite at 41.4121,-83.8780: paved 50-ft electric back-ins 017-023 sit ~15-30 m from the Maumee, over open bank with no screen, but the row's loop road runs between pads and river, so view at best. Site 8 is in the south loop ~180 m back behind woods; tent-only 24-39 don't count.

name: Kokosing Valley Camp & Canoe
evidence: Operator map campmap2022.png: every riverside row (C, D, T) is seasonal; nightly 30-amp sites are only 103-125C and Areas A and B. Satellite at 40.3972,-82.2815: nearest nightly row 103-125C is ~80 m from the Kokosing, behind the loop road, the seasonal row and a bank tree band.

name: Alum Creek State Park
evidence: ReserveOhio per-site plot + satellite at 40.2378,-82.9788: web-bookable 45-ft electric site B36 has its RV ~10-15 m from the shore, a bare bank gap showing through a thin tree belt; K23 (47 ft) is similar at 40.2428,-82.9820. Most other loops are wooded and farther back. On-water at these few sites only.

name: Ashland RV Park
evidence: Satellite at 39.4372,-81.4680: lowest row pads ~15-25 m from the Muskingum would earn riverfront, but they hold parked rigs while upper pads sit empty, matching 26 seasonal sites and the stored note; no source shows them sold nightly. Upper nightly rows ~50-55 m back across open grass and the lane, with thin bank trees: view holds.

name: Coshocton Lake Park Campground
evidence: Redone from the sites, satellite at 40.2880,-81.8778: gravel back-in rows sit in a clearing; a continuous wooded band separates them from the Walhonding, ~70 m to the west and ~145 m to the south. No sightline. The swim pond is day-use by the aquatic center, with no pads on it.

name: Foxfire Campground
evidence: Operator map puts nightly 200-208 on the outer loop by Brokensword Creek, ~20-30 m from the bank on leaf-off satellite at 40.8356,-83.1093, but the operator's 'Creekside View' photo shows a continuous leafy tree wall with no water visible. Screened, so no creekside or view. No nightly site fronts the central pond.

name: Guilford Lake State Park
evidence: ReserveOhio per-site plot + satellite z19 at 40.8066,-80.8782: west-row electric back-ins 17-29 (36-44 ft, bookable) sit ~20-27 m from the high-water edge across open unused lawn with scattered trees and docks, road on the far side. Drawdown doesn't change the measure. The lead's 100+ m for this row doesn't hold.
